versions.changelog:
listenhub 0.1.0 — Initial release

- Enables instant creation of podcasts, explainer videos, voice narration, or AI-generated images from user content.
- Supports input via topics, YouTube links, article URLs, plain text, and image prompts.
- Features clear user modes: Podcast (dialogue), Explain (video), TTS (voice only), and Image Generation.
- All operations must use provided shell scripts; direct API use is explicitly forbidden.
- Auto-detection of user intent with guidance for ambiguous cases, emphasizing simplicity and security.
